name: MA-Net (Multi-scale Attention Network)
authors_or_creators: Zengqun Zhao, Qingshan Liu, Shanmin Wang (Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology)
publication_venue: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP), vol. 30, pp. 6544-6556, 2021
backbone: ResNet-based feature pre-extractor (modified ResNet-18 / ResNet variant) with multi-scale module and local attention module
pretrained_weights_available: yes - pretrained models and training logs released on the official GitHub repository
inference_fps_or_latency: [uncertain] (not explicitly reported; designed for in-the-wild FER, runs on a single GPU)
hardware_requirements: Training reported on NVIDIA GPU (single GPU sufficient); inference on single consumer GPU [uncertain on exact GPU model]
training_data_used: Trained/evaluated on RAF-DB, AffectNet (7 and 8 class), CAER-S, and SFEW 2.0
pretraining_strategy: face-recognition-pretrain (backbone initialized from a face-recognition pretrained model, e.g. on MS-Celeb-1M) [uncertain on exact corpus]
cross_dataset_generalization: [uncertain] (no explicit cross-dataset transfer numbers reported; generalization shown via consistent SOTA across four in-the-wild datasets: RAF-DB, AffectNet, CAER-S, SFEW 2.0)
robustness: Designed for in-the-wild robustness: multi-scale module fuses features with different receptive fields to reduce susceptibility to occlusion/pose variation; local attention module focuses on salient regions. Explicit Occlusion-RAF / Pose-RAF benchmarks [uncertain]
explainability: Attention map visualization via local attention module (visualized in the paper)
